crossRefs.note: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following…
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet.…
He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and…
After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not…
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to…
Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love…
“Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond…
But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin
translations.asv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before you, that ye sin not.
